Becoming

Born in southern Colombia. Still building, still learning.

“To be able at any moment to sacrifice what we are for what we could become.”

Charles Du Bos

Engineer by training. Artist by curiosity. Teacher by choice.

I grew up in a small town in southern Colombia, trying to understand the world through art, philosophy and history. I studied electronic engineering, researched how to read emotions from brain signals, and ran art and technology labs before moving into XR and games.

Today I lead engineering at Teravision Games and teach AI and software architecture to graduate students. I still work where those fields meet.
